To obtain bail, a bail bond needs to be executed, with or without the presence of sureties.   In motor accident cases both the owner and driver of the vehicle are liable to face prosecution proceedings initiated before the Motor Accident Claim Tribunal once an FIR is lodged in the police station in hit and run case and the legal heirs of the deceased victim and the injured persons apply to the Tribunal under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 within six months of the occurrence of the accident.  Section 164 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended in 2019) states that the owner of the motor vehicle or the authorized insurer shall be liable to pay compensation of five lakh rupees in case of death or two and a half lakh rupees in case of grievous hurt to the legal heirs or the victim, as the case may be. The claimant is not required to prove that the death or grievous hurt was due to any wrongful act or neglect of the owner or any other person. Ltd. and the judgment passed by the Rajasthan High Court in the case of Ganesh Bairwa VS Ramphool Bairwa may be referred. Fine as a penalty is imposed only if there is a criminal prosecution. You have to establish the fact before the Court denying that you were not driving the vehicle rashly and that the accident arose not on account of your negligence. You have to take the defense that in spite of cautious driving you met with an accident. Unless you plead guilty generally fine is not imposed.
